DESCRIPTION: Global naming conventions for MAST thomson_scattering IDS. MAST's HRTS system changed signal naming at shot 22832: AYC_* for shots 22832-30471, ATM_* for shots 1-22831. The JSON plugin cannot apply shot-range logic at the mapping level — the AYC signals are mapped here as primary. For older shots (< 22832), substitute ATM_TE, ATM_NE, ATM_PE, ATM_R at the ingestion layer.
_COMMENT_signals: AYC = HRTS primary (shots 22832+). ATM = HRTS legacy (shots 1-22831). The radial position signal AYC_R gives per-channel R positions and is used to drive the channel count.
